original_source.identity: numeric tag plus year; original authors report no recapture or sighting of banded birds in other years

scientific_question: Does the fraction of independently sampled local random depth plots close to an earlier learned bird-specific used-depth target predict later target matching better than absolute local depth heterogeneity, after adjusting mean-depth mismatch?
bird_target: For each source bird-year, order strict source-matched events by source Year/Julian/event number. Use first floor(n/2) used depths to define median target mu. Remaining observations are the untouched chronological test. Require >=6 train and >=6 test. Primary target is inclusive mu plus/minus 6 cm; sensitivity plus/minus 10 cm, no rescue.
strict_source: Missing Yes and malformed source IDs excluded, exactly one used water depth and two source random plot depths in a valid event. Do not infer XY or physical reachable sites from sampled randoms.

heldout_definitions.K: fraction of two contemporaneous random plot depths in trained target band; sampled availability proxy only (0, 0.5, 1)
heldout_definitions.H: absolute difference of two random plot depths, cm
heldout_definitions.M: absolute difference of their mean and trained target mu, cm
heldout_definitions.Y: indicator actual test used water depth is in trained target band
heldout_definitions.delta: Y-K, equal-bird-year mean and 10k bird bootstrap CI

primary_gate: At least 8 of 10 original bird-years must have >=2 distinct K categories on test events; else STOP_K_SUPPORT and do not broaden target band.
frozen_models: 10 leave-one-bird-year-out logistic folds, L2=1 slopes-only. Compare M-only, M+H, M+K, M+H+K with numeric M,H divided by 10cm. Bird-equal log-loss and 10k bird-bootstrap intervals; primary added K contrast = logloss(M+H) minus logloss(M+H+K). Report even when negative.
sensitivity: Use primary same estimates with target band +/-10 cm as separately labeled exploratory source-scoped sensitivity, not a replacement.
hard_boundaries: All calculations from already-opened same King Rail source are exploratory and post-hoc.
Two local random depths are sparse availability samples, not independently measured reachable state mass K.
Y=1 when sampled K=0 means the two reference plots missed an observed suitable state, not biological movement overcoming absent physical capacity.
A trained-depth preference is descriptive, not independent physiological requirement or optimal fitness state.
Identity counted as original bird×year because the 2023 original paper states no cross-year recaptures.
Past event depth and GPS locations have no authoritative event-by-event linkage; no geographic cause or movement benefit inferred.
